title: Adversarial Fragility and Language Vulnerability in Clinical AI: A Systematic Audit of Diagnostic Collapse Under Imperceptible Perturbations and Cross-Lingual Drift in Low-Resource Healthcare Settings
reasoning: The study evaluates clinical AI models for adversarial robustness and linguistic fairness (specifically Nigerian Pidgin and Yoruba-inflected English). While it addresses 'algorithmic inequity' and mentions clinical safety and governance, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethical systems.
